title: Connor Smith
text:
Welcome to my personal website. I am a Lecturer (Teaching and Leadership) at Macquarie University, passionate about teaching and learning in statistics or anything that can use statistics.
Browse my Teaching page to learn more about my courses, teaching philosophy, and resources.

title: About
text: I am a Lecturer (Teaching and Leadership) in the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences at Macquarie University, with a 70% teaching and 30% leadership role. My research interests include variable selection, stability selection, complex modelling, and statistical graphics.
